declarations.--add-dir: Add a directory to the workspace (repeatable) (default [])
declarations.--agent: Agent for the current CLI session
declarations.--conversation: Resume a previous conversation by ID
declarations.--dangerously-skip-permissions: Auto-approve all tool permission requests without prompting
declarations.--disable-slash-commands: Disable slash command and skill expansion in print mode
declarations.--effort: Reasoning effort for the current CLI session (low|medium|high)
declarations.--input-format: Input format for print mode (text, stream-json). stream-json reads one NDJSON message per line from stdin and runs a turn for each; it requires --output-format stream-json (default text)
declarations.--json-schema: Optional JSON schema string or path to a schema file to enforce structured output (for stream-json, only applicable to the final result)
declarations.--mode: Set the agent execution mode for this session (accept-edits, plan)
declarations.--model: Model for the current CLI session
declarations.--new-project: Create a new project for this session
declarations.--output-format: Output format for print mode (text, json, stream-json) (default text)
declarations.--print: Run a single prompt non-interactively and print the response
declarations.--project: Project ID or project name for the current CLI session
declarations.--prompt-interactive: Run an initial prompt interactively and continue the session
declarations.--sandbox: Run in a sandbox with terminal restrictions enabled

credential_mode: AGY runtime authentication only; no API-key fallback

probe.auth_state: host OAuth credential staged read-only; guest imports it into disposable Credential Manager
